neper.notes: ROUND 77 (looks77-k), measured with an own comparer against ref/flutter/neper/light/textfield-outlined-rest (252 x 56, outline rows 22 to 77): the field is now 256 x 48 (outline rows 357 to 404 in the sheet, light and dark; was 40), the height of the text_edit, mask_edit, button_edit and autocomplete fields; Flutter's 56 is the same recorded deviation as theirs (4 px grid, 40 px pointer control). Cause: overlay.clocked_field_glyph used the 40 pointer height; Neper pointer hosts now use control_lg (touch stays 56). 'Open, day hover' now hovers Thursday the 15th: 806 pixels differ from the Open cell in a 32 x 32 circle (bbox 540,448 to 571,479), the day circle size of the calendar, light and dark. Non-Neper PNGs byte-identical. Recorded in flutter-compare-k.md.

neper.notes: ROUND 77 (looks77-k): (1) 'Open, scrolling' now shows its field (150 x 48) with the list 4 px under it: past seven rows a Neper list scrolls in a 252 px viewport (control.suggesting_wide) instead of squeezing 22 rows into the window; label ink pitch measured 36 px (290, 326, 362, 398, 434, 470, 506), hover band on row 1 and active band on row 3 whole rows, no half-row offset (the pointer aim for the cell is 43 px). (2) Drop button hot and pressed: the value ends 4 px earlier (end space +4, Neper only), so the 32 px circle no longer touches the last letter (ink ends at x 546, circle starts at 568 in the sheet). (3) Windows-capture sheets (combo_box_dialog, _edit, _focus, _held, _pick, _search_held, _flat*, _open_*, _list_* and edits_*, combo_hover, native_dark_open*) no longer write Neper pictures: they reproduce 22 px Windows fields at fixed window y and crushed Neper fields (empty values); looks.windows_capture. native_dark shows Bravo in the hover-arrow cell. Field 150 x 48 against Flutter DropdownMenu 56, list rows 36 against 48: recorded (flutter-compare-k.md).
